modules.title: 开发延期以后，依赖它的测试和发布日期怎样变化
甘特图需要呈现哪些排期信息

items.title: 横条编码起止和持续时间
items.text: 横条在时间轴上的位置表示开始和结束，长度表示持续时间，不能只依靠颜色区分任务。

items.title: 依赖说明任务怎样相互影响
items.text: 当前置任务推迟时，连接的后续任务和里程碑可能一起移动，依赖关系应当可以追溯。

items.title: 估算必须保留不确定性
items.text: 未知工期、外部审批和高风险依赖需要明确标记，图表的整齐不能代替真实依据。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: {c:gantt-chart} 关心已经选定任务何时开始、持续多久以及依赖谁；{c:product-roadmap} 关心产品为什么向某个方向发展；{c:product-backlog} 关心候选工作当前怎样排序。

lessonPractice.title: 下面哪组信息最适合进入“行程协作功能”的甘特图？

options.label: 交互设计 3 天；完成后才能开发 5 天；开发结束后测试 2 天；测试通过是发布里程碑
options.feedback: 对。这组信息包含具体任务、持续时间、依赖和里程碑，可以放到时间轴上检查排期。

options.label: 今年希望让更多旅行者能够顺利与同行者协作
options.feedback: 这是产品目标和方向，适合路线图；它还没有形成可以安排起止时间的具体任务。

options.label: 所有未知任务都先填明天下午完成，让图表看起来完整
options.feedback: 虚构日期会让依赖和风险失真。缺少估算时应明确标注待确认。

en.title: Which information belongs in the Gantt chart for a trip-collaboration feature?

options.label: Interaction design takes 3 days; development takes 5 days after design; testing takes 2 days after development; passing tests is the release milestone
options.feedback: Correct. It contains tasks, durations, dependencies, and a milestone that can be placed on a timeline.

options.label: This year we want more travelers to collaborate successfully with companions
options.feedback: That is a product goal suited to a roadmap, not yet a set of schedulable tasks.

options.label: Set every unknown task to finish tomorrow afternoon so the chart looks complete
options.feedback: Invented dates distort dependencies and risk. Unknown estimates should remain visibly unresolved.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请根据这些已经确认的任务、负责人、工期和依赖，为“行程协作功能”整理甘特图初稿。标出任务起止、依赖线和发布里程碑，并模拟开发延期 2 天后的影响。缺少工期或依赖的项目标成待估算，不要补假日期。最后列出会改变发布日期的依赖和仍需确认的风险。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Using these confirmed tasks, owners, durations, and dependencies, draft a Gantt chart for the trip-collaboration feature. Show task dates, dependency links, and the release milestone, then simulate a two-day development delay. Mark missing durations or dependencies as estimates needed instead of inventing dates. Finish with the dependencies that can move the release and the risks still open.

references.title: 使用甘特图视图
references.title_en: Work with the Gantt Chart View

learning.assumes: You need to coordinate task timing and sequence but may confuse direction, ordering, and scheduling.
learning.outcome: You can read task dates, duration, dependencies, and milestones from a Gantt chart and identify what a delay affects.

modules.title: See how a development delay moves testing and release
What a Gantt chart needs to show

items.title: Bars encode dates and duration
items.text: Position shows start and finish, while length shows duration.

items.title: Dependencies expose schedule impact
items.text: When a predecessor moves, connected tasks and milestones may move with it.

items.title: Estimates preserve uncertainty
items.text: Unknown duration, external approval, and risky dependencies need visible labels rather than invented dates.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A {c:gantt-chart} schedules selected tasks, a {c:product-roadmap} explains product direction, and a {c:product-backlog} orders candidate work.
